summary: "Fire and Rain" is a folk rock song written and performed by James Taylor. Released by Warner Bros. Records in February 1970 as a single from his second album, Sweet Baby James, it reflects on Taylor's reaction to the suicide of childhood friend Suzanne Schnerr and on his experiences with drug addiction and fame. The single reached number two on RPM's Canada Top Singles chart and number three on the Billboard Hot 100.
one_line: A 1970 folk rock single by James Taylor from the album Sweet Baby James, reflecting on a friend's suicide and his own struggles with addiction and fame.

The song also addresses James Taylor's experiences with drug addiction and fame.
After its release, "Fire and Rain" peaked at number two on RPM's Canada Top Singles chart.
After its release, "Fire and Rain" peaked at number three on the Billboard Hot 100.
